Package org.jdesktop.lg3d.utils.shape

Class ShaderEffects

java.lang.Object
org.jdesktop.lg3d.utils.shape.ShaderEffects
public final class ShaderEffects extends Object
The entry point to the native 3D desktop's GPU shader effects: a small factory over the lg3d sg facade's GLSL plumbing (ShaderAppearance / GLSLShaderProgram / SourceCodeShader) that the port inherited from Java 3D 1.7 but, until now, only one demo app (cdviewer) ever used.

Everything here is opt-in: effects are gated behind the SHADERS_PROPERTY system property (-Dlg.shaders=true), which defaults to false so the desktop renders exactly as it always has through the fixed-function path until the shader effects are turned on and live-verified. Callers must therefore treat a null return from the builders here as "shaders off / unavailable, fall back to the legacy widget".

The GLSL is authored in the legacy 1.20 dialect (varying, gl_FragColor, gl_ModelViewProjectionMatrix) because that is what Jogamp Java 3D 1.7.2's GLSLShaderProgram binds and what the one proven in-tree shader (cdviewer's dimple) uses; modern in/out GLSL is not assumed to link. Shader sources live as classpath resources under utils/shape/resources/ (the same src/classes-as-resource-dir model that ships dimple.vert).

  • Method Details

    • isEnabled

      public static boolean isEnabled()
      Whether the GPU shader effects are enabled. Reads lg.shaders afresh each call (no caching) so a test or a live toggle is honoured; the value is only consulted when a decoration is built, not per frame.

    • softShadowProgram

      public static ShaderProgram softShadowProgram()
      Builds the soft-drop-shadow ShaderProgram from the bundled GLSL, or returns null when the sources are missing or the program cannot be assembled. Constructing the program object needs no GL context (only rendering one does), so this is safe to call while building a scene graph.

    • frostedGlassProgram

      public static ShaderProgram frostedGlassProgram()
      Builds the frosted-glass rounded-panel ShaderProgram from the bundled GLSL, or returns null when the sources are missing or the program cannot be assembled - the same graceful-fallback contract as softShadowProgram() so a caller can drop back to a legacy GlassyPanel when shaders are off or unavailable.
